tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every page; the site is light-first.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: Secondary surface: homepage doorway panels, the Competition page's FAQ rows, cards, alternating sections.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and display type on paper and paper-2. Also the big solid slab in hero layouts.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, corner labels, metadata. Passes 4.5:1 on paper and paper-2.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections and rows of the Essentials list. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Main warm accent, from the colour-grid moodboard image. Fills, shapes and buttons, with on-accent text on top. Not for body text on paper (too low contrast).

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Deep warm accent that is safe as text: links and highlighted words on paper (passes 4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Soft relief tint for mosaic tiles and backgrounds behind callouts. ink text on top (works in both themes).

tokens.name: edition
tokens.usage: The current edition's SDG colour. Inaugural Edition = SDG 2 mustard. Swap this one token each edition; use it for one accent shape per screen (the disc), never for text. on-accent text on top.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on coral or edition fills, in both themes (the dark theme's ink is light, so it can't be used there).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero only: the hook on the cover. Can be cropped off the edge like the aurea poster, but the same words must also appear in plain text nearby.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Section openers and the edition title.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings inside content pages and blog posts.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Write one essay, up to 800 words, on one of three prompts.
styles.usage: Intro paragraphs and the Essentials answers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Entry costs USD 10. If you can't afford it, email us and we'll waive it, no questions asked.
styles.usage: All running text: rules, FAQ, blog. Never smaller than 16px on mobile.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Small uppercase corner labels and metadata, like the tiny text in the Visual Systems layout. Short phrases only, never sentences.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a component; mosaic tile gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Padding inside rows and buttons; mobile page margin.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; desktop page margin; mosaic tile size.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space between major sections. Generous empty space is part of the look.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Blocks, tiles, images and the Essentials panel are square, editorial-style.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Only for floating cards laid over an image (the nature-overlay pattern).

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Circles and pill buttons: the edition disc, the Enter button.
